name: vip.witnessd/witnessd
description: Neutral third-party witness: independently fetch, hash, timestamp, archive any URL or API response.

environmentVariables.name: WITNESSD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the witnessd service (default https://witnessd.vip)

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet key used to auto-pay x402 invoices in USDC on Base (either this or WITNESSD_API_KEY)

environmentVariables.name: WITNESSD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid witnessd credit key (alternative to EVM_PRIVATE_KEY)
